[IDOL TOUR – Global Friends in Busan] IG Goddess Ep.1

Today’s guests are Apink’s Cho Rong and Bo Mi and a Japanese friend Rui! (feat. Visit Busan Pass)
Our newbie(?) Busan tour guides, Cho Rong and Bo Mi, will give you a tour of hot spots in Busan,
which might make you feel confused and dizzy.
The three girls, who are serious about taking photos, will take their fresh💦 and lively💦 best shots in Busan.

From the world’s first! two head tall(?) runway walking of female K-pop idols and a TikToker to soul
food Mukbang on the street on the Haeundae beach~
We guarantee you will have so much fun with a combination of these three hyperenergetic girls
like unstoppable locomotives!
